# `combinational-delay`: Combinational logic uses a nonblocking assignment / 组合逻辑中使用了非阻塞赋值

**Severity / 严重程度:** `warning`

## English

### Cause

A combinational process uses a nonblocking assignment (<=), which defers its update instead of immediately updating the value like a blocking assignment (=).

### Risk

Deferred updates can make simulation behavior differ from the combinational intent; Verilator may convert the assignment to blocking execution.

### Fix

Use blocking assignments (=) for combinational logic and reserve nonblocking assignments (<=) for appropriate clocked sequential processes.

## 简体中文

### 原因

组合过程使用了非阻塞赋值（<=），其更新会被推迟，而不是像阻塞赋值（=）一样立即更新值。

### 风险

推迟更新可能使仿真行为偏离组合逻辑的设计意图；Verilator 可能将该赋值转换为阻塞执行。

### 修复

组合逻辑使用阻塞赋值（=），非阻塞赋值（<=）用于适当的时钟触发时序过程。

## Failing example / 问题示例

```systemverilog
module combinational_delay(input logic a, input logic b, output logic y);
  always_comb begin
    y <= a & b;
  end
endmodule
```

## Fixed example / 修复示例

```systemverilog
module combinational_delay(input logic a, input logic b, output logic y);
  always_comb begin
    y = a & b;
  end
endmodule
```
